_about: Design tokens for the CRM, dark theme. Roles, not brand: replica-brand changes values, never names. tokens.json (light) and tokens.dark.json (dark) have the same keys; only color and shadow differ. Check every change with: python3 .claude/skills/replica-design/contrast.py <file>. Then run python3 replica/design/build_tokens.py to regenerate tokens.css and tailwind.css.
_source: replica/design/measurements.md (measured system of the original), replica/design/decisions.md (context decisions). 2026-10-06.

_roles.bg: Page canvas behind cards and between blocks.
_roles.surface: Cards, tables, app header, sidebar, inputs.
_roles.surface-subtle: Quiet bands inside a surface: table footer, sticky toolbars, alternate form sections.
_roles.surface-raised: Menus, popovers, selects, dialogs, drawers, toasts. Light: white plus shadow. Dark: one step lighter than surface.
_roles.surface-sunken: Recessed areas: table header row, inactive steps, read-only fields, segmented-control track, skeleton blocks.
_roles.surface-hover: Hover and keyboard highlight for rows, menu items and ghost buttons.
_roles.border: Decorative dividers and card edges. No contrast rule applies.
_roles.border-strong: Stronger decorative lines: under the table header, between panels.
_roles.border-input: The edge that identifies a control: input, select, checkbox, radio, switch track. 3:1 on every fill it sits on.
_roles.text-muted: Secondary text: labels, placeholders, timestamps, help text, inactive tabs and icons. 4.5:1 wherever text goes.
_roles.accent: PLACEHOLDER for our brand colour; replica-brand sets the value. Primary buttons, links, active nav, checked controls, selected-tab bar.
_roles.accent-hover: Hover and pressed state of accent fills and links.
_roles.accent-subtle: Selected rows, active nav item fill, accent chips.
_roles.on-accent: Text and icons on accent and accent-hover fills.
_roles.focus-ring: 2px outline on :focus-visible, offset 2px (or -2px inside rows and menus). Never draw the inset ring over an accent or danger fill. There the ring colour is on-accent (or on-danger): focus-visible:outline-on-accent.
_roles.<tone>: danger, success, warning, info: status text, icons, row markers and solid fills.
_roles.danger-hover: Hover and pressed fill of the solid danger button. Darker than danger in light, lighter in dark.
_roles.<tone>-subtle: Status pill and callout backgrounds. Pills put <tone> text on <tone>-subtle.
_roles.on-<tone>: Text and icons on a solid <tone> fill (danger button, solid badge).
_roles.inverse: Tooltips only. Nothing focusable sits on it.
_roles.overlay: Scrim behind dialogs and drawers. Not checked: it is never a text background.
_roles.chart-surface: Plot area of a chart card. Same as surface.
_roles.chart-1..8: Categorical series. Fixed order, assigned in sequence, never cycled. Not for status.
_roles.chart-ordinal-1..6: One-hue ramp for ordered stages (funnel). 1 = first stage, least contrast with the surface; 6 = last stage, most.

_changes: accent placeholder: pure neutral grey (light #404040, dark #c4c4c4, OKLCH chroma 0), so no hue from the original is carried over. accent-hover, accent-subtle and focus-ring are greys too (focus-ring equals accent until /replica-brand). measurements.md's #4b5563 was dropped: it sits at the original's hue (OKLCH 257) and only 1.26:1 from text-muted. The earlier slate (#354053) was dropped for the same reason (OKLCH hue 261). Separation kept: accent is 1.73:1 from text-muted and 1.69:1 from text in light, 1.39:1 from text-muted in dark.
text-subtle dropped: text-muted is close to the lightest grey that passes 4.5:1 on surface-sunken (4.92:1 light). A lighter third grey fails; a darker one duplicates text-muted.
surface roles: measurements.md surface-strong becomes surface-sunken; surface-subtle is kept. surface-hover is added for row and menu highlight.
type: lg is 20/30, not 20/28, and xl is 24/36. decisions.md requires line height >= 1.5 for text that can hold a user-entered name (deep Telugu and Kannada subscripts).

chart light slots 2-5 (orange, aqua, yellow, magenta) re-stepped darker than the dataviz reference so every slot is >= 3.1:1 on bg. Hue anchors and order kept. validate_palette.py: worst adjacent CVD dE 10.0, worst normal dE 18.5, first three slots pass all-pairs. Dark slots are the reference steps unchanged (worst adjacent CVD dE 8.4).

chart slot 1 and the ordinal ramp moved from OKLCH hue 255 to 232 (cerulean). At 255 they were within ΔE2000 2.8 of the original's brand blue. Every new value is at least ΔE2000 11.8 from the original's accent family. Ramp: OKLCH L steps of 0.064 on hue 232, so hex rounding keeps every gap >= 0.06. Light end >= 3:1, not only the 2:1 the dataviz method asks, so contrast.py can check it as ui. /replica-brand keeps chart-1 and the ramp at least ΔE2000 10 from the original's accent family.
controls: measured 30 px toolbar controls become 32; 24-25 px menu items become 32; 20 px chips become 24; 13 px native checkboxes become 16 px with a 24 px hit area (decisions.md, 2.5.8).
radius: measured 0 / 2 / 4 / pill. Toolbar buttons and the search field are not pill-shaped in our system (part of the original look); pill stays for avatars, status pills and switches.
large text: no pair is marked large. Every text pair passes 4.5:1, so none needs the 3:1 large-text allowance.
danger-hover added (light #8f1f1d, dark #f9b3ad): 1.37:1 from danger in both themes, close to the accent-hover step. on-danger on it is 8.82:1 (light) and 10.96:1 (dark).

pairs added so later palette changes are gated: on-danger on danger-hover; text, text-muted and focus-ring (ui) on chart-surface; warning, success and info on surface-hover (tone icons on hovered tabs and rows).

neutrals: bg and surface-sunken are within ΔE2000 0.2 and 1.4 of the original's canvas and table-header greys (measurements.md, Greys palette). Greys are not ownable; /replica-brand tints them toward our brand hue.

font.sans: Inter, "Noto Sans Devanagari", "Noto Sans Bengali", "Noto Sans Gurmukhi", "Noto Sans Gujarati", "Noto Sans Oriya", "Noto Sans Tamil", "Noto Sans Telugu", "Noto Sans Kannada", "Noto Sans Malayalam", "Noto Naskh Arabic", system-ui, sans-serif

font-var._about: CSS variable that next/font/local sets for each self-hosted family. tokens.css writes var(--font-x, "Family") so the stack works with or without next/font. Put the next/font variable classes on <html>, not <body>, or :root resolves them to the fallback.

type._about: px. size/line/default weight. Every step that can hold user-entered text has line >= 1.5 x size. display is for numbers only (KPI values).

layout._about: px. Data tables and boards run full width; other pages stop at content-max.

size._about: px. Heights of controls and rows, and minimum hit areas.
